verdict.rationale: Fastmail exposes a documented developer API built on the open JMAP standard, with API tokens, OAuth/Bearer auth, a session endpoint and batched method calls. The jmap.io page lists a Rust library and a TypeScript library, but nothing shows these are official, Fastmail-maintained SDKs rather than ecosystem implementations of the protocol. Missing for 10: confirmed official Fastmail SDKs with language coverage, SDK reference docs and versioning, an OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
